mechanism_note: LITERAL Elman test: prediction-INDUCED rep (q=M*sparse_key at verb position) vs RAW-BIND rep (sparse_key, no store) -- ONE variable = store applied. Both L2-normalized. Inspectable closed-form probes: prototype (cosine) + ridge-linear ((X^T X + lam I)^-1 X^T y). Discriminator = pred beats SAME probe on raw by >=0.05. Structure-shuffle = word-order permutation (bag preserved, syntax destroyed) drop >=0.1. Novel-lexeme held-out (subjects disjoint; random per-token atoms).
